description: Test suite for the LangsmithLogger component within the litellm framework, including various unit tests for credential handling, batch grouping, dot order generation, serialization validation, HTTP batch sending, key-based logging, and queue behavior.
external_files: httpx (implied from mocking async HTTP client)

classes.name: LangsmithLogger
classes.description: A logger class for integrating Langsmith with litellm, supporting batch logging, credential management, and HTTP communication.

classes.name: LangsmithQueueObject
classes.description: Represents a queued data object with associated credentials for Langsmith batch processing.

classes.name: CredentialsKey
classes.description: A key class for grouping batch objects by their credentials.

classes.name: BatchGroup
classes.description: A group of LangsmithQueueObjects sharing the same credentials for batch processing.

methods.name: test_get_credentials_from_env()
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of credentials from environment variables and direct parameters.

methods.name: test_group_batches_by_credentials()
methods.description: Tests grouping of queue objects by identical credentials.

methods.name: test_group_batches_by_credentials_multiple_credentials()
methods.description: Tests grouping with multiple distinct credentials.

methods.name: test_make_dot_order()
methods.description: Tests generation of unique dot order string including timestamp and run ID.

methods.name: test_is_serializable()
methods.description: Tests the serializability check for various data types and models.

methods.name: test_async_send_batch()
methods.description: Tests asynchronously sending a batch of logs via HTTP post.

methods.name: test_langsmith_key_based_logging(mocker)
methods.description: Tests logging with credentials provided directly via API key and project, including request body validation.

methods.name: test_langsmith_queue_logging()
methods.description: Tests queue behavior and batch flushing when logging calls are made rapidly.
